# NEW 2026-11-18 fourth round D1 (tributary ladder and buying peace). Generated by gen_round4_tributary.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Any scope. Imperial Authority change, kept within 0..100 (nothing when the variable is missing).
oe_ttb_auth = {
    international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars ?= {
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_pillars_authority }
            change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = $amount$ }
            clamp_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority min = 0 max = 100 }
        }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. Debug counter: one event fired by this track's scheduler (or one AI offer).
oe_ttb_count = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dbg_n_ttb } } set_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_ttb value = 0 } }
    change_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_ttb add = 1 }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- suzerainty
# BYZ scope, monthly. Gained at authority >= 50, lost below 40 (oe_ttb_test_hold keeps a test grant).
oe_ttb_suzerain_check = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_ttb_suzerain } oe_ttb_auth_high = yes }
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ttb_suzerain years = -1 }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ttb_q_lost } remove_variable = oe_ttb_q_lost }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ttb_suz_seen } } set_variable = oe_ttb_suz_seen set_variable = oe_ttb_q_gain }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_ttb_suzerain oe_ttb_auth_low = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_ttb_test_hold } }
        remove_country_modifier = oe_ttb_suzerain
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ttb_q_gain } remove_variable = oe_ttb_q_gain }
        set_variable = oe_ttb_q_lost
    }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- tributaries
# Country scope. Clears this track's tributary variables.
oe_ttb_clear_trib = {
    remove_variable = oe_ttb_invested
    remove_variable = oe_ttb_months
    remove_variable = oe_ttb_q_invest
    remove_variable = oe_ttb_q_promote
    remove_variable = oe_ttb_wait
}
# Country scope (a tributary of BYZ), monthly. A new one is invested (queued for oe_ttb.1); the others count months.
oe_ttb_trib_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ttb_invested } }
        set_variable = oe_ttb_invested
        set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_months value = 0 }
        set_variable = oe_ttb_q_invest
    }
    else = {
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ttb_months } } set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_months value = 0 } }
        change_variable = { name = oe_ttb_months add = 1 }
    }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- buying peace
# Country scope (the target). Ends the agreement on its side without penalty.
oe_ttb_peace_clear = {
    remove_variable = oe_ttb_peace
    remove_variable = oe_ttb_peace_recent
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:BYZ has_opinion = { modifier = oe_ttb_peace_op target = c:BYZ } }
        remove_opinion = { modifier = oe_ttb_peace_op target = c:BYZ }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. Counts the running agreements into var:oe_ttb_peace_n.
oe_ttb_recount = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_peace_n value = 0 }
    every_country = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_ttb_peace }
        c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_ttb_peace_n add = 1 } }
    }
}
# Country scope, monthly, for every country carrying this track's variables (BYZ pulse). Stale tributary variables
# go; an agreement ends without penalty when war breaks out between the two or the target becomes a BYZ subject;
# the agreements still running are counted (var:oe_ttb_peace_n was set to 0 before the loop).
oe_ttb_sweep = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_ttb_invested NOT = { oe_ttb_is_trib = yes } }
        oe_ttb_clear_trib = yes
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_ttb_peace OR = { is_at_war_with = c:BYZ is_subject_or_below_of = c:BYZ } }
        if = {
            limit = { is_at_war_with = c:BYZ }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_q_end value = 2 }
            c:BYZ = { set_variable = oe_ttb_q_end_any }
        }
        oe_ttb_peace_clear = yes
    }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ttb_peace } c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_ttb_peace_n add = 1 } } }
}
# BYZ scope; scope:oe_ttb_t = the target. Ends every war between the two: white peace when both lead their sides;
# otherwise whichever of the two is not its side's leader leaves the war (leave_war, the other as actor).
oe_ttb_end_wars = {
    every_current_war = {
        limit = { is_on_opposite_sides = { country = c:BYZ target = scope:oe_ttb_t } }
        save_scope_as = oe_ttb_w
        if = {
            limit = {
                OR = { attacker_leader = scope:oe_ttb_t defender_leader = scope:oe_ttb_t }
                OR = { attacker_leader = c:BYZ defender_leader = c:BYZ }
            }
            white_peace = scope:oe_ttb_w
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { NOT = { OR = { attacker_leader = scope:oe_ttb_t defender_leader = scope:oe_ttb_t } } }
            scope:oe_ttb_t = { leave_war = { war = scope:oe_ttb_w actor = c:BYZ } }
        }
        else = {
            c:BYZ = { leave_war = { war = scope:oe_ttb_w actor = scope:oe_ttb_t } }
        }
    }
}
# BYZ scope; scope:oe_ttb_t = the target. The target accepted: wars end, truce, costs, first year paid (the senate
# reacts to the payment: oe_ttb_sen_on_pay).
oe_ttb_peace_sign = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = oe_ttb_amt value = oe_ttb_peace_amount }
    if = { limit = { is_at_war_with = scope:oe_ttb_t } oe_ttb_end_wars = yes }
    add_truce_with = { target = scope:oe_ttb_t years = 5 mutual = yes }
    add_prestige = -15
    oe_ttb_auth = { amount = -5 }
    add_gold = { value = scope:oe_ttb_amt multiply = -1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_ev_amt value = scope:oe_ttb_amt }
    oe_ttb_sen_on_pay = { amount = scope:oe_ttb_amt }
    scope:oe_ttb_t = {
        add_gold = scope:oe_ttb_amt
        set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_peace value = scope:oe_ttb_amt years = 5 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_peace_recent months = 6 }
        remove_variable = oe_ttb_refused
        if = { limit = { has_opinion = { modifier = oe_ttb_peace_op target = c:BYZ } } remove_opinion = { modifier = oe_ttb_peace_op target = c:BYZ } }
        add_opinion = { modifier = oe_ttb_peace_op target = c:BYZ }
    }
    oe_ttb_recount = yes
}
# BYZ scope; scope:oe_ttb_t = the target. The target refuses: no cost, no new envoy to it for 12 months.
oe_ttb_peace_refuse = {
    scope:oe_ttb_t = { set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_refused months = 12 } }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ttb.6
}
# BYZ scope; scope:oe_ttb_t = the target (from the hidden worker oe_ttb.8). Decides and answers.
oe_ttb_peace_decide = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_ev_t value = scope:oe_ttb_t }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ttb_ev_war } remove_variable = oe_ttb_ev_war }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ttb_roll_ok } remove_variable = oe_ttb_roll_ok }
    if = {
        limit = { is_at_war_with = scope:oe_ttb_t }
        if = {
            limit = { scope:oe_ttb_t = { oe_ttb_winning_vs_byz = yes } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_ev_why value = 1 }
            oe_ttb_peace_refuse = yes
        }
        else = {
            set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_ev_war value = 1 }
            oe_ttb_peace_sign = yes
            trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ttb.5
        }
    }
    else = {
        random = { chance = oe_ttb_accept_chance set_variable = oe_ttb_roll_ok }
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_ttb_roll_ok }
            remove_variable = oe_ttb_roll_ok
            oe_ttb_peace_sign = yes
            trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ttb.5
        }
        else = {
            set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_ev_why value = 2 }
            oe_ttb_peace_refuse = yes
        }
    }
}
# BYZ scope; var:oe_ttb_offer = the target. Contract: sends the envoy (the hidden worker decides).
oe_ttb_send_envoy = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ttb_offer } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ttb.8 }
}
# BYZ scope; scope:oe_ttb_t = the target. Byzantium breaks the agreement (unpaid, or stopped by the action):
# the truce goes both ways, prestige -10, the target's opinion of Byzantium -40 for 5 years.
oe_ttb_peace_break = {
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_ttb_t }
        if = { limit = { has_truce_with = scope:oe_ttb_t } remove_truce_with = scope:oe_ttb_t }
        scope:oe_ttb_t = {
            if = { limit = { has_truce_with = c:BYZ } remove_truce_with = c:BYZ }
            oe_ttb_peace_clear = yes
            add_opinion = { modifier = oe_ttb_broken target = c:BYZ }
        }
        add_prestige = -10
        oe_ttb_recount = yes
    }
}
# BYZ scope, every January. Pays every agreement not signed in the last 6 months; one it cannot pay is broken.
# Each payment also reaches the senate (oe_ttb_sen_on_pay). While the AI insurance holds payments back
# (var:oe_ttb_ai_hold = 1, AI rules only), each payment is held back instead: oe_ttb_ai_held.
oe_ttb_peace_january = {
    every_country = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_ttb_peace NOT = { has_variable = oe_ttb_peace_recent } }
        save_scope_as = oe_ttb_t
        save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = oe_ttb_due value = var:oe_ttb_peace }
        if = {
            limit = { c:BYZ = { oe_ttb_ai_rules = yes var:oe_ttb_ai_hold ?= 1 } oe_ttb_ai_holdable = yes }
            c:BYZ = { oe_ttb_ai_held = yes }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { c:BYZ = { gold >= scope:oe_ttb_due } }
            c:BYZ = { add_gold = { value = scope:oe_ttb_due multiply = -1 } oe_ttb_sen_on_pay = { amount = scope:oe_ttb_due } }
            add_gold = scope:oe_ttb_due
        }
        else = {
            set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_q_end value = 1 }
            c:BYZ = { set_variable = oe_ttb_q_end_any oe_ttb_peace_break = yes }
        }
    }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- pulse
# BYZ scope, monthly (on_action oe_ttb_byz_pulse).
oe_ttb_byz_monthly = {
    oe_ttb_suzerain_check = yes
    oe_ttb_sen_monthly = yes
    set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_peace_n value = 0 }
    every_country = {
        limit = { OR = { has_variable = oe_ttb_invested has_variable = oe_ttb_peace } }
        oe_ttb_sweep = yes
    }
    every_subject = { limit = { is_subject_type = tributary } oe_ttb_trib_monthly = yes }
    if = { limit = { oe_ttb_ai_rules = yes } oe_ttb_ai_fisc = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { OR = { has_variable = oe_ttb_ai_red has_variable = oe_ttb_ai_hold } } oe_ttb_ai_fisc_clear = yes }
    if = { limit = { current_month = 1 } oe_ttb_january = yes }
    if = { limit = { is_ai = yes } oe_ttb_ai_monthly = yes }
    oe_ttb_dispatch = yes
}
# BYZ scope, January. Tribute payments; tributaries ready to rise are queued for oe_ttb.2.
oe_ttb_january = {
    oe_ttb_peace_january = yes
    every_subject = { limit = { oe_ttb_promote_ready = yes } set_variable = oe_ttb_q_promote }
}
# BYZ scope. At most one scheduled event of this track a month (the senate news oe_ttb_sen.1 last).
oe_ttb_dispatch = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_ttb_q_end_any NOT = { any_country = { has_variable = oe_ttb_q_end } } }
        remove_variable = oe_ttb_q_end_any
    }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ttb_q_end_any } oe_ttb_count = yes trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ttb.7 }
    else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ttb_q_lost } oe_ttb_count = yes trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ttb.4 }
    else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ttb_q_gain } oe_ttb_count = yes trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ttb.3 }
    else_if = { limit = { any_subject = { has_variable = oe_ttb_q_invest } } oe_ttb_count = yes trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ttb.1 }
    else_if = { limit = { any_subject = { has_variable = oe_ttb_q_promote } } oe_ttb_count = yes trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ttb.2 }
    else = { oe_ttb_sen_dispatch = yes }
}
# BYZ scope, monthly when Byzantium is AI. Buys peace from a neighbour more than 2 times as strong while the
# authority is below 40; one offer every 6 months at most; none while the senate condemns the tribute, and
# none while the AI insurance holds payments back.
oe_ttb_ai_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_ttb_ai_cd }
            NOT = { var:oe_ttb_ai_hold ?= 1 }
            oe_ttb_auth_low = yes
            oe_ttb_sen_ai_ok = yes
            oe_ttb_can_offer = yes
            any_country = { oe_ttb_ai_target = yes }
        }
        oe_ttb_ai_offer = yes
    }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- AI insurance (docstring item 9)
# BYZ scope, monthly under the AI rules, before the January payments. var:oe_ttb_ai_red: months in a row with the
# treasury below 0; var:oe_ttb_ai_ok: months in a row with at least the year's dues (oe_ttb_ai_dues) in it. Payments
# are held back from 3 months in the red and paid again after 3 months recovered (var:oe_ttb_ai_hold 1 / 0).
oe_ttb_ai_fisc = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ttb_ai_red } } set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_ai_red value = 0 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ttb_ai_ok } } set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_ai_ok value = 0 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ttb_ai_hold } } set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_ai_hold value = 0 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ttb_ai_held_n } } set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_ai_held_n value = 0 } }
    if = {
        limit = { gold < 0 }
        change_variable = { name = oe_ttb_ai_red add = 1 }
        clamp_variable = { name = oe_ttb_ai_red min = 0 max = 120 }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_ai_red value = 0 } }
    # the dues are summed only when an agreement runs (var:oe_ttb_peace_n was just recounted by the sweep)
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_ttb_peace_n var:oe_ttb_peace_n >= 1 }
        save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = oe_ttb_ai_need value = oe_ttb_ai_dues }
    }
    else = { save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = oe_ttb_ai_need value = 0 } }
    if = {
        limit = { gold >= scope:oe_ttb_ai_need }
        change_variable = { name = oe_ttb_ai_ok add = 1 }
        clamp_variable = { name = oe_ttb_ai_ok min = 0 max = 120 }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_ai_ok value = 0 } }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:oe_ttb_ai_hold ?= 1 } var:oe_ttb_ai_red >= 3 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_ai_hold value = 1 }
        debug_log = "OEBYZ ai: tribute payments held back (treasury below 0 for 3 months in a row)"
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_ttb_ai_hold ?= 1 var:oe_ttb_ai_ok >= 3 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_ai_hold value = 0 }
        debug_log = "OEBYZ ai: tribute payments resumed (treasury held the year's dues for 3 months in a row)"
    }
}
# BYZ scope. Byzantium is player-run again (and no test runs): the insurance's state goes; the player's rules apply.
oe_ttb_ai_fisc_clear = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ttb_ai_red } remove_variable = oe_ttb_ai_red }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ttb_ai_ok } remove_variable = oe_ttb_ai_ok }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ttb_ai_hold } remove_variable = oe_ttb_ai_hold }
}
# BYZ scope; scope:oe_ttb_t = the payee. One January payment held back: no gold moves, the agreement and its truce
# stay; prestige -5; the payee's opinion of Byzantium -20 for 24 months (refreshed).
oe_ttb_ai_held = {
    add_prestige = -5
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ttb_ai_held_n } } set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_ai_held_n value = 0 } }
    change_variable = { name = oe_ttb_ai_held_n add = 1 }
    scope:oe_ttb_t = {
        if = { limit = { has_opinion = { modifier = oe_ttb_arrears target = c:BYZ } } remove_opinion = { modifier = oe_ttb_arrears target = c:BYZ } }
        add_opinion = { modifier = oe_ttb_arrears target = c:BYZ }
    }
    debug_log = "OEBYZ ai: a January tribute payment held back"
}
# BYZ scope. The AI picks a target and sends the envoy.
oe_ttb_ai_offer = {
    random_country = { limit = { oe_ttb_ai_target = yes } save_scope_as = oe_ttb_ai_t }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_ttb_ai_t }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_ai_cd months = 6 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_offer value = scope:oe_ttb_ai_t }
        oe_ttb_count = yes
        oe_ttb_send_envoy = yes
    }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- test helpers (dev mod buttons and console; BYZ scope)
# Suzerainty now, whatever the authority (kept for 12 months against the monthly check); opens oe_ttb.3.
oe_ttb_test_suz_on = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_ttb_suzerain } } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ttb_suzerain years = -1 } }
    set_variable = oe_ttb_suz_seen
    set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_test_hold months = 12 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ttb_q_lost } remove_variable = oe_ttb_q_lost }
    set_variable = oe_ttb_q_gain
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ttb.3
}
# Suzerainty off now; opens oe_ttb.4 (the monthly check gives it back at authority >= 50).
oe_ttb_test_suz_off = {
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_ttb_suzerain } remove_country_modifier = oe_ttb_suzerain }
    remove_variable = oe_ttb_test_hold
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ttb_q_gain } remove_variable = oe_ttb_q_gain }
    set_variable = oe_ttb_q_lost
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ttb.4
}
# A random independent neighbour becomes a tributary of Byzantium (scope:oe_ttb_tt). Investiture follows next month.
oe_ttb_test_make = {
    random_country = { limit = { oe_ttb_test_make_ok = yes } save_scope_as = oe_ttb_tt }
    scope:oe_ttb_tt ?= { make_subject_of = { target = c:BYZ type = subject_type:tributary } }
}
# scope:oe_ttb_tt = a tributary of Byzantium (an existing one, else a new one).
oe_ttb_test_pick = {
    if = {
        limit = { any_subject = { is_subject_type = tributary } }
        random_subject = { limit = { is_subject_type = tributary } save_scope_as = oe_ttb_tt }
    }
    else = { oe_ttb_test_make = yes }
}
# Investiture now for a tributary (oe_ttb.1).
oe_ttb_test_invest = {
    oe_ttb_test_pick = yes
    scope:oe_ttb_tt ?= {
        set_variable = oe_ttb_invested
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ttb_months } } set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_months value = 0 } }
        set_variable = oe_ttb_q_invest
    }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_ttb_tt } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ttb.1 }
}
# Promotion now: a tributary gets 120 months and the proposal oe_ttb.2 opens (opinion and church not checked).
oe_ttb_test_promote = {
    oe_ttb_test_pick = yes
    scope:oe_ttb_tt ?= {
        set_variable = oe_ttb_invested
        set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_months value = 120 }
        remove_variable = oe_ttb_wait
        set_variable = oe_ttb_q_promote
    }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_ttb_tt } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ttb.2 }
}
# A peace payment starts now with a valid target (else any neighbour without an agreement), without the answer roll.
oe_ttb_test_peace_start = {
    if = {
        limit = { any_country = { oe_ttb_peace_target_ok = yes } }
        random_country = { limit = { oe_ttb_peace_target_ok = yes } save_scope_as = oe_ttb_t }
    }
    else = {
        random_country = {
            limit = { country_type = location NOT = { tag = BYZ } NOT = { has_variable = oe_ttb_peace } NOT = { is_subject_or_below_of = c:BYZ } is_neighbor_of_country_or_across_one_seazone = c:BYZ }
            save_scope_as = oe_ttb_t
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_ttb_t }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_ev_t value = scope:oe_ttb_t }
        if = { limit = { is_at_war_with = scope:oe_ttb_t } set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_ev_war value = 1 } }
        else = { remove_variable = oe_ttb_ev_war }
        oe_ttb_peace_sign = yes
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ttb.5
    }
}
# The normal offer (with the answer roll) to a valid target.
oe_ttb_test_peace_offer = {
    random_country = { limit = { oe_ttb_peace_target_ok = yes } save_scope_as = oe_ttb_tt }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_ttb_tt }
        scope:oe_ttb_tt = { remove_variable = oe_ttb_refused }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_offer value = scope:oe_ttb_tt }
        oe_ttb_send_envoy = yes
    }
}
# Stops one running agreement with the full penalty (as the action does).
oe_ttb_test_peace_stop = {
    random_country = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ttb_peace } save_scope_as = oe_ttb_t }
    oe_ttb_peace_break = yes
}
# The January payment now, also for agreements signed in the last 6 months; breach notices fire at once.
oe_ttb_test_january = {
    every_country = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ttb_peace_recent } remove_variable = oe_ttb_peace_recent }
    oe_ttb_peace_january = yes
    oe_ttb_recount = yes
    oe_ttb_dispatch = yes
}
# The AI path once, without its cooldown and authority condition.
oe_ttb_test_ai = {
    remove_variable = oe_ttb_ai_cd
    if = { limit = { oe_ttb_can_offer = yes any_country = { oe_ttb_ai_target = yes } } oe_ttb_ai_offer = yes }
}
# AI insurance (item 9). The AI rules run for 12 months (also in a player's game), then payments are held back now.
oe_ttb_ai_test_hold = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_ai_test months = 12 }
    oe_ttb_ai_fisc = yes
    set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_ai_red value = 3 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_ai_ok value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_ai_hold value = 1 }
}
# The AI rules run for 12 months, and payments are made again now.
oe_ttb_ai_test_resume = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_ai_test months = 12 }
    oe_ttb_ai_fisc = yes
    set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_ai_red value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_ai_ok value = 3 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_ai_hold value = 0 }
}
# The AI rules run for 12 months, and the monthly treasury check runs once now (it also runs every month).
oe_ttb_ai_test_month = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_ai_test months = 12 }
    oe_ttb_ai_fisc = yes
}
# Test over: back to the player's rules; counters, hold and the held-payment count are cleared.
oe_ttb_ai_test_off = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ttb_ai_test } remove_variable = oe_ttb_ai_test }
    oe_ttb_ai_fisc_clear = yes
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ttb_ai_held_n } remove_variable = oe_ttb_ai_held_n }
}
